issues.title: Probability renormalization for P(TIE) clipping
issues.description: P(TIE) = 1 - P(A) - P(B) - P(BOTH_BAD) could be clipped to epsilon without renormalizing the other probabilities, breaking the probability simplex. Fixed by normalizing all 4 probabilities to sum to 1 after clipping.

issues.title: Per-system tie propensity (gamma extension)
issues.description: The original model uses a single global lambda for tie probability. Extended with per-system gamma_k parameters: lam_ij = base_lam * exp(gamma_i + gamma_j), with L2 regularization on gamma (tuned via 5-fold CV, best l2_gamma=0.1). This allows different systems to have different tie tendencies while preserving the grounded BOTH_BAD structure. CV NLL improved from 1.0355 to 1.0340.

issues.title: Optimizer convergence and initialization
issues.description: Improved L-BFGS-B convergence with tighter tolerances (ftol=1e-14, gtol=1e-10, maxiter=10000) and better lambda initialization (log(0.3) starting near the fitted value instead of log(1)=0 starting at lambda=2). Multi-restart analysis confirmed unique global optimum.

summary: Optimized GRK model by extending with per-system tie propensity parameters (gamma_k) and probability renormalization. Global test NLL improved from 0.9556 to 0.9526, ECE from 0.1542 to 0.1502. Improvement consistent across all three test splits (global/instrumental/vocal). GRK vs AB-MNL advantage widened from -0.0789 to -0.0819 NLL. All pairwise significance tests remain strongly significant.
